idea-plugin.name: Nightbrew
idea-plugin.description:
Nightbrew — a late-night theme for devs who run on coffee and prompts.

Soft blue-black surfaces, iOS-bright accents and calm contrast for long sessions.


After installing, go to Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance and select Nightbrew Cove.


Want more moods? Nightbrew Pro adds Kiln (warm graphite & terracotta) and Roast (coffee & caramel).

Enjoying it? Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
